rendered: Lead-acid cell: the document says almost 70%[1] of the mass of a lead-acid cell is lead or lead oxide. Li-ion cell: active cathode material (e.g., NMC622) accounts for around 30%[2] of the cell weight. The first share is therefore about 2.33[3] times the second, so the lead-acid share is roughly that many times larger. In Fig. 2[4] the same comparison reads lead at 69%[5] of the lead-acid cell and NMC622 at 31.8%[6] of the Li-ion cell.
